summary: Inventory caching is off by default and needs enabling via ANSIBLE_INVENTORY_CACHE, [inventory] cache=True or cache: True in a plugin's YAML source. The plugin is chosen with ANSIBLE_INVENTORY_CACHE_PLUGIN, cache_plugin in ansible.cfg or the YAML config, otherwise falling back to the fact cache plugin. Not all inventory plugins support caching.
questions: How do I turn on caching for my aws_ec2 dynamic inventory?
Which setting chooses the cache backend for inventory?
Is inventory caching enabled by default?
What happens if I enable inventory cache but don't set a cache plugin?
Can I use a collection's cache plugin for inventory?

answer_card.title: Enabling inventory caching
answer_card.answer_md:
Inventory caching is disabled by default. Enable it with any of:

```shell
export ANSIBLE_INVENTORY_CACHE=True
```
```ini
[inventory]
cache=True
```
```yaml
# dev.aws_ec2.yaml
plugin: aws_ec2
cache: True
```

Pick the cache plugin with `ANSIBLE_INVENTORY_CACHE_PLUGIN=jsonfile`, `cache_plugin=jsonfile` under `[inventory]`, or `cache_plugin: jsonfile` in the YAML source. Use the FQCN for collection plugins.

If no inventory cache plugin is set, the fact cache plugin is used. Check that your inventory plugin supports caching.
